results.title: She Harvested a $40,000 Stock Gain at the 0% Rate. It Still Made 85% of Her Social Security Taxable.
results.description: She sold stock at a profit, paid zero federal tax on the gain, and still ended up with a surprise bill. The culprit was not the stock sale itself but what the gain quietly did to her Social Security.
